name: Shackleton rim (LOLA Site04 reference point)
coordinateSource: Centre pixel of NASA PGDA LOLA 5 m/px Site04 DEM (https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/data/LOLA_5mpp/Site04/Site04_final_adj_5mpp_surf.tif), DE421 MOON_ME; see data/reference/site-provenance.json. Reference point, not a landing target.

name: Connecting ridge (LOLA Site01 reference point)
coordinateSource: Centre pixel of NASA PGDA LOLA 5 m/px Site01 DEM (https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/data/LOLA_5mpp/Site01/Site01_final_adj_5mpp_surf.tif), DE421 MOON_ME; see data/reference/site-provenance.json. Reference point, not a landing target.

name: Malapert massif (LOLA Site23 reference point)
coordinateSource: Centre pixel of NASA PGDA LOLA 5 m/px Site23 DEM (https://pgda.gsfc.nasa.gov/data/LOLA_5mpp/Site23/Site23_final_adj_5mpp_surf.tif), DE421 MOON_ME; see data/reference/site-provenance.json. Reference point, not a landing target.

name: IM-2 Athena intended landing site (Mons Mouton)
coordinateSource: LROC 'IM-2 Landing Region' (https://lroc.im-ldi.com/images/1401): intended landing site -84.78°, 29.13°E. Pre-landing target; the actual touchdown point was not published there.
notes: Intended target rounded to 0.01°; Athena landed tipped over somewhere near it.

name: Chandrayaan-3 landing site (Shiv Shakti point)
notes: Outside the 80°S 20 m DEM; horizon uses the 120 m 60°S DEM only.

name: Chang'e-6 landing site (far side, Apollo basin)
coordinateSource: LROC 'First Look: Chang'e 6' (https://lroc.im-ldi.com/images/1374): 41.6385°S, 206.0148°E (= 153.9852°W), -5256 m, ±30 m horizontal.
notes: Contrast case: on the far side Earth never rises. Outside polar DEMs, so the horizon is a bare sphere.

name: Apollo 11 Lunar Module (Tranquility Base)
coordinateSource: NASA NSSDC Apollo landing site coordinates (https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/lunar/lunar_sites.html), LM position from LRO images, Mean Earth/Polar Axis DE421 (Wagner et al., Icarus 283, 92-103, 2017).
notes: Equatorial contrast case. Outside polar DEMs, so the horizon is a bare sphere.
